items.headline: Bruno Fernandes ruled out of Portugal Nations League with complicated injury
items.summary: Manchester United captain Bruno Fernandes withdrawn from Portugal squad during international break with significant injury concerns.

items.headline: Patrick Dorgu withdrawn from Denmark squad with hamstring injury
items.summary: Winger Patrick Dorgu limped off during Denmark's Nations League match and was withdrawn entirely from squad.

items.headline: Noussair Mazraoui forced off with injury during Morocco match
items.summary: Defender Mazraoui landed awkwardly winning the ball and was replaced by Achraf Hakimi after 69 minutes.

items.headline: Carlos Baleba training at Carrington as recovery progresses
items.summary: New signing continues comeback from injury, pictured in gym and on grass at Carrington training facility.

items.headline: Carrick preparing for League Cup third round vs Brighton
items.summary: Manager has selection decisions to make for Carabao Cup clash at home to Brighton & Hove Albion on Wednesday.
